summary: This directory provides a collection of utility functions designed to facilitate the creation of test data structures, specifically for analyzing package and directory configurations during the testing lifecycle.
responsibilities: Generate mock directory structures for testing environments
Construct data objects representing directory and package analysis states
Provide reusable test data builders to support automated test suites
relationships: Test data builders generate mock structures that populate the analysis models for verification.
The analysis models define the schema required by the testing framework to validate directory and package states.
designDecisions: Centralization of test helper logic to avoid code duplication in test files
Utilization of factory functions for object creation to maintain data consistency during tests
